content.tagline: A full-cycle plant: formula, packaging and production under your brand
content.descriptor: Korean OEM/ODM manufacturer in Incheon: face, body and hair care, sheet and hydrogel masks, and its own packaging production
about: HANSCOS CO., LTD is a Korean full-cycle cosmetics manufacturer. The plant and office are in Incheon, the company has been working since 2009 and, by its own account, has developed more than five thousand formulations.

One group holds three parts that usually have to be sourced separately. HANSCOS handles development and production, C PROPACK makes the packaging: bottles, jars, tubes, pumps, caps and boxes. HANS LABELLE sells the finished goods through an online mall and a network of 162 franchise stores across Korea.

For a client this means the formula, the container and the box are costed in one place. When packaging comes from an outside contractor, lead times stack up one after another and responsibility for mismatches gets diluted.

The plant has been audited to ISO 22716, with certificates issued by Bureau Veritas and EuroCert. The company also states CGMP, holds a quasi-drug manufacturing licence, a The Vegan Society registration and FOASU trademarks in the United States and China.
facts: Plant and office in Incheon, Republic of Korea; the company has been working since 2009
By the company's account, more than 5,000 formulations developed
ISO 22716: certificates from Bureau Veritas and EuroCert; the company also states CGMP
Quasi-drug manufacturing licence and a The Vegan Society registration
A second plant and a second mask production line launched in 2022
In-house packaging production at C PROPACK: bottles, jars, tubes, pumps, caps, boxes and gift sets
Own retail through HANS LABELLE: an online mall and 162 franchise stores in Korea
channels: Brands looking for a contract manufacturer (OEM/ODM)
Importers and distributors launching a private label
Retail chains with their own trade mark
Salons and clinics that need a line under their own name
Marketplaces and e-commerce with an own brand

lines.name: Face masks
lines.note: Sheet and hydrogel masks. Masks have a dedicated production line, with a second one launched in 2022. The minimum order is 20,000 units for sheet masks and 30,000 units for hydrogel masks per item.

lines.name: Face care
lines.note: Toners, essences, serums, ampoules, creams and mists. The plant's main direction, with a minimum order of 5,000 units per item.

lines.name: Body and hair care
lines.note: Body and hair products run through the same cycle: formulation, filling and packaging inside one group.

lines.name: Bulk semi-finished product
lines.note: The company also supplies the product unfilled, where the client has its own filling line.

lines.name: C PROPACK packaging
lines.note: Bottles, jars, tubes, pumps and caps of its own production, together with individual boxes, SET boxes, gift sets and bags.

tech.name: A full cycle in one pair of hands
tech.note: Development, design, production and packaging supply sit inside one group. The client does not have to align a laboratory, a container maker and a printer between themselves.

tech.name: Ready formulations instead of development from scratch
tech.note: By the company's account more than five thousand formulations have been accumulated. For a project on a limited budget this means an existing formula is more often adapted than a new one written.

tech.name: ISO 22716 with two auditors
tech.note: The ISO 22716 certificates were issued by Bureau Veritas and EuroCert. Copies are in the company's materials and are handed to the buyer at the deal stage.

tech.name: Own retail as a check
tech.note: HANS LABELLE is an online mall and 162 franchise stores. The plant produces not only for other brands but under its own name, and sees the result at the shelf.

tech.name: Export trade-show record
tech.note: COSMOBEAUTY SEOUL 2022, Sao Paulo Beauty Fair 2022, Dubai Beautyworld Middle East 2022, Cosmoprof Las Vegas 2023 and VietBeauty 2023.

content.exportNote: The company works for export and has taken part in trade shows in Korea, Brazil, the UAE, the United States and Vietnam. Teranova covers Latin and North America and matches the plant with the markets and channels where a client needs the full cycle, packaging included, in one place.

terms.label: Forms of cooperation
terms.value: OEM and ODM: production under the client's brand on a ready or adapted formulation. Bulk semi-finished product and C PROPACK packaging are supplied separately.

terms.label: Minimum order
terms.value: Skincare: 5,000 units per item. Sheet masks: 20,000 units. Hydrogel masks: 30,000 units per item.

terms.label: Production lead time
terms.value: About 60 working days after the formulation, design and packaging are finally agreed.

terms.label: Payment terms
terms.value: 50% prepayment on order placement and 50% before shipment, within 10 days of the notice that the goods are ready.

terms.label: Prices
terms.value: Price on request. We do not publish the plant's wholesale prices openly: the calculation depends on the formulation, the packaging and the batch volume. The buyer receives current terms at the deal stage through Teranova, as a separate line from the cost of our services.

terms.label: Samples and documents
terms.value: The company hands over product samples and copies of certificates while the project is being discussed.

content.consentNote: Data, images and materials are provided by HANSCOS CO., LTD and published with its consent, given at a meeting in the company's Incheon office on 27 August 2026. Stated properties and terms are given on the company's information. Wholesale prices are not published at the company's request.
